title: Refractory Materials Repairers, Except Brickmasons
description: Build or repair equipment such as furnaces, kilns, cupolas, boilers, converters, ladles, soaking pits, and ovens, using refractory materials.

tasks.text: Reline or repair ladles and pouring spouts with refractory clay, using trowels.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual repair of worn mechanical parts

dwas.name: Repair worn, damaged, or defective mechanical parts.

tasks.text: Chip slag from linings of ladles or remove linings when beyond repair, using hammers and chisels.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Cleaning parts for repair needs hands-on dexterity

dwas.name: Clean equipment, parts, or tools to repair or maintain them in good working order.

tasks.text: Mix specified amounts of sand, clay, mortar powder, and water to form refractory clay or mortar, using shovels or mixing machines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on mixing of compounds in physical workspace

dwas.name: Prepare compounds or solutions to be used for repairs.

tasks.text: Measure furnace walls to determine dimensions and cut required number of sheets from plastic block, using saws.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical distance measurement in field

dwas.name: Measure distances or dimensions.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

dwas.name: Cut materials according to specifications or needs.

tasks.text: Dry and bake new linings by placing inverted linings over burners, building fires in ladles, or by using blowtorches.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Part fabrication requires physical machining and handling

tasks.text: Remove worn or damaged plastic block refractory linings of furnaces, using hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Structural repair is hands-on physical work

tasks.text: Climb scaffolding, carrying hoses, and spray surfaces of cupolas with refractory mixtures, using spray equipment.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Climbing structures requires physical mobility

dwas.name: Climb equipment or structures to access work areas.

tasks.text: Spread mortar on stopper heads and rods, using trowels, and slide brick sleeves over rods to form refractory jackets.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Sealing gaps requires hands-on application

dwas.name: Seal gaps or cracks to prevent leakage or moisture intrusion.

tasks.text: Dump and tamp clay in molds, using tamping tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual placement of materials into molds

tasks.text: Transfer clay structures to curing ovens, melting tanks, and drawing kilns, using forklifts.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Operating heavy equipment by hand in field

dwas.name: Move large objects using heavy equipment.
